answer: Each identity must register a unique IPv4 /24 prefix that the verifier checks against a public routing table, and a prefix counts only after it has been announced from its own autonomous system for 30 days. Leasing such a block costs about 3,000 dollars, and regional registries release them slowly, so a farm cannot mint identities in bulk. Nodes sharing a mesa of cloud instances collapse onto one prefix, while a spread across a tundra of regions or a delta of carriers needs a separate lease for each head.
